promo-mk-muted.title: Etsy mutes your mockup video #shorts
promo-mk-muted.description:
Here is the scrolling mockup most people make: a phone-shaped video, 9 by 16, the tall screenshot scrolling slowly for thirty seconds, a nice music track underneath.

Now hold it against Etsy's own help page. A listing video may be 3–15 seconds long — thirty is twice the limit. It will not contain any audio once uploaded — the music is gone. And the aspect ratio should be 2:1 or 1:2 — 9 by 16 is neither.

Length, sound and shape: all three fail. Build it at 1080 × 2160 instead.

promo-mk-ten.title: The scrolling mockup, built to Etsy's rules #shorts
promo-mk-ten.description:
The same scrolling mockup, rebuilt to Etsy's rules. A custom size of 1080 × 2160 — exactly 1:2, and the shape of a phone screen anyway.

The scroll is ten seconds, and that is not a choice: Canva's help page says each animation can only be ten seconds long at the maximum. Two seconds of the cover before it starts, two seconds of the last page after it stops — fourteen seconds, inside Etsy's fifteen, and no music at all.

The words on screen do the talking, because on Etsy they are the only thing that will.

promo-mk-silent.title: Nobody hears your Etsy listing video #shorts
promo-mk-silent.description:
Etsy removes the audio from listing videos, so watch yours with the sound off and ask what a shopper actually learns.

Put the important facts on screen as text — how many pages, what size, that it is editable in Canva. One short line at a time, big enough to read on a phone held at arm's length.

And put the first line on the very first frame. Shoppers are scrolling past dozens of listings, and whatever is on screen in the first second is all most of them will ever see.

promo-mk-two.title: Etsy gives you two listing videos. Use both #shorts
promo-mk-two.description:
Etsy's own help page: you can add up to two videos per listing. Almost everyone adds one or none.

Make the second one do a different job. The first is the scroll — what is inside. The second is what happens after they buy: the template opening in Canva, a name being typed in, a colour being changed. Proof that it is editable, which is the question every digital buyer is really asking.

Build it the same way: 1:2, under fifteen seconds, silent, text on screen.
